data.raw_text:
$NAKA | @NakamotoGames

Another Sunday, another savage week of execution across the most relentless GameFi ecosystem in #Web3.

Here’s what went down this week 👇

MONDAY
Started strong with two major engines firing:

• $NAKA Boom entered final prep, the Web3 bomber game everyone’s waiting for. Launch is near. 💣
• Watch2Earn is LIVE → Watch ads, spin the Lucky Wheel, and grind for that $1 Ticket.
• Works on Web, PWA & Android - rewards are waiting. 🎡

TUESDAY
Mass adoption play goes full throttle:

• $NAKA launched in-app ads in India, Vietnam & the Philippines.
• A bold Web2 → Web3 funnel targeting hyper-casual gamers where it counts.
• Streaming gameplay directly from the app also got kicked off.
→ Share, go viral and drive adoption.

WEDNESDAY
A brand new game reveal: Trick or Seek

• Multiplayer hide-and-seek in a neon anime world.
• Switch roles. Cause chaos. Hunt spirits.
• Gameplay is fire. Aesthetic is retro-futuristic madness.
• Coming soon to Playland and ready to flip the genre on its head.

Also: the countdown to the next $1 to Earn tournament started ticking...

THURSDAY
BOOM. $1 to Earn Tournament went live!

• Jump into Sky Hover, turn $1 into $100.
• All hosted on the app - fast, fair, rewarding.
• $NAKA Boom hit final bug testing + UI polish.
→ Full launch window: August

FRIDAY
No matter the market, $NAKA builds.

• Team doubled down during the bear.
• Now they’re going ALL-IN as interest returns.
• The goal? To take $NAKA fully mainstream.
• App-ready, name conflict solved.
• UX/UI upgrades locked in.
• Mobile fun at its peak.

Also: say hello to Fall Race (formerly Rumble Party)

SATURDAY
 Blazor is heating up:

• Deep gameplay testing, bug fixes, UI redesign in the works.
• Balancing power-ups and polishing combat to perfection.
• Launching in August. This is tactical GameFi done right.

Also: $NAKA Farm Island earnings now unlocked. Get in, stack up. 🌾

SUNDAY
Closed the week with power moves:

• Sushi Match NEXT submitted to iOS - sleek, fast and P2E-ready.
• And the big one: XSwap is LIVE → Fiat to $NAKA now smooth, secure, seamless.

This ecosystem doesn’t sleep.
This team doesn’t slow down.
This is what real building looks like.

I'm Scooping.

They are the blueprint.
Watch them dominate.
Let’s keep it rolling, 
 🔥🎮
